entries.en: The wandering minstrel of Revenant's Toll would like you to wet his whistle.
entries.fr: Le ménestrel errant souhaiterait que vous invoquiez une créature légendaire.
entries.ja: レヴナンツトールの異邦の詩人は、冒険者に伝説の幻獣を呼び出してほしいようだ。

entries.en: Much has the wandering minstrel heard of your legendary deeds, but he is more interested in your knowledge of legendary steeds. Upon discovering that you have a full stable of magicked mounts at your beck and call, a revelation dawns on him: could you be the one of whom the ancient hermit spoke, all those years ago? The one who can sound the mystic whistle he has carried with him ever since, and call forth the beast of legend? Convinced that this hero is you, he bids you take the pipe to a suitable stage─the crystal cliffs of Rathefrost─and blow with all your might.
entries.fr: Vous avez discuté avec le ménestrel et celui-ci vous a montré un objet servant à invoquer une créature légendaire, mais qui ne remplirait sa fonction qu'entre les mains de quelqu'un d'héroïque. Il pense justement que vous seriez tout à fait capable d'un tel exploit vu que vous avez déjà dompté les destriers des Primordiaux. Il n'y a qu'un moyen de le savoir : rendez-vous dans le Mor Dhona, et dirigez-vous à l'endroit indiqué dans les environs de Hâtegel. Utilisez ensuite  que le ménestrel vous a donné.

entries.en: You climb the glowing pathway to the Rathefrost cliffs, and blow the magicked dizi beneath the crystal branches. As its piercing note echoes in the air, a mythical Kirin appears before your very eyes. The minstrel emerges from his hiding place, full awed by the sight of the legendary beast, and declares that his word was true: you are indeed the hero to whom the Kirin has pledged its fealty. Whensoever you call upon it with a blast from the whistle, the immortal beast will return to you from its otherworldly kingdom, and whisk you wheresoever you please. And so a new chapter in your epic saga begins...

entries.en: How good it is to see you again, ! Little have I had to wander in search of inspiration these past moons, for the very air resounds with word of your valorous deeds. Are the rumors true? The primals of Eorzea resurrected in ever more ferocious forms, only to meet a swift end at your hand?

Steeds of darkness, gifted to the beast tribes by the servants of evil as mounts for their unholy armies. ...Or so the rumors have it, for neither sable hide nor inky hair have I seen firsthand.

entries.en: I wish for you to have this whistle. I collected it during my wanderings in the East─a gift from an ancient hermit who lived a life of seclusion atop a holy mountain. At the time, I thought it a poor reward for climbing to the top of that godsforsaken peak.

entries.en: But as I turned to go, the hermit spake unto me thus: “The gift I give you is no mundane instrument. Only a matchless hero may sound its clarion call, and summon the ageless one... A legend to call a legend forth!”
entries.fr: Il a bien entendu accompagné son geste de quelques explications : “Seul un guerrier, dont la sagesse n'a d'égale que l'expérience, verra apparaître sous ses yeux une créature fière et légendaire lorsqu'il portera à sa bouche ce cor et qu'en lui il soufflera...”

entries.en: Colt that I was, I thought him senile─a broken man with a broken whistle. And yet, there was something in the passion of his voice, the glint in his eyes, that told me he was speaking true. Though my lips have never mustered a single peep from the thing, I have kept it at my side ever since.
entries.fr: J'ai évidemment essayé de jouer un petit air avec cet instrument, pensez-vous ! Mais je ne suis qu'un simple ménestrel, pas un héros, et rien ne s'est produit...

一介の語り部に過ぎない僕には、英雄たる資格なんてない。

entries.en: Full faith have I that your heroic lips will succeed where my merely musical ones failed. What an honor it shall be to bear witness to the first encounter between the greatest hero of our time, and a mythical creature the like of which the world has never seen! What a song I shall make of it!

Forgive me for wishing to add a touch of theater to an already auspicious event, but if you would indulge me this once, I would be eternally grateful.

entries.en: That the Kirin has responded to your summons can mean only one thing: it assents to your command. It is as I always knew it would be, from the very moment we met... You are the one the hermit spoke of─the legend fit to call the legend forth!
entries.fr: Si le Kirin a répondu à votre appel, c'est que vous êtes  digne du héros dont l'ermite m'avait parlé.
entries.ja:
「麒麟」は、君の呼びかけに応えた。
そう、主人として認めたということさ。
……やはり、君は仙人が語るところの「英雄」だったんだね。

To bend its knee to a hero brave, and for its strength to lend.♪

entries.en: I have but one request, : as you ride out into the wide world atop your legendary steed, do not forget to return to me once in a while and recount your adventures. People the realm over may shout your praises, but who among them can set them to verse as well as I?
